texts: Walton Lillehei pioneered controlled cross-circulation in 1954, using a parent's heart and lungs to support a child during open heart repair: C is the answer.
Gibbon performed the first successful operation with a heart-lung machine in 1953, and Bigelow pioneered hypothermia.
Kirklin developed the pump oxygenator further at the Mayo Clinic.
Memory hook: a lily grows out of the hay, Lille-hei, while the father pumps for his son.
